messages.author: ab78e227e394cf1d
messages.subject: Fast computation in INLA
parts:
Hi INLA members,

I am trying to compute a poisson model with several random effects (10) and a set of fixed effects. It is taking very long time to run in HPC. Is there any suggestions by controlling a few control.inla parameters for fast computation in INLA?

I do have a large data  with 2,435,419 rows. Any suggestions will help.

Alokesh.

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Fast computation in INLA
parts:
Hi,

Because the computation time is linear in the number of data entries, what matters for computation speed in INLA is the distribution/size of the random effects (sometimes if it is correctly specified from the computation point of view) and the number of hyper-parameters. The total computation time the setup time plus the time per iteration times the number of function evaluations. Can you say something about it?

best regards,
Elias
